name: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo: Jigoku Yuuen Satsujin Jiken
original_name: 金田一少年の事件簿 地獄遊園殺人事件
source:
In this case Kindaichi & Mijuki were having a discussion when they found that the police had found a man hanged in a park, so Kindaichi offers his help and goes to investigate the theme park and that's when the game starts.

[From [url=http://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/K/SLPS-01340.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
本案中，金田一与美雪正在交谈，得知警方在一座公园发现一名遭绞死的男子。金田一主动提出协助，前往主题公园调查，游戏也由此开始。

[摘自[url=http://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/K/SLPS-01340.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
